decision.rationale: TXN-008120 is on card CRD-000105. It was posted on 2026-07-18 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, 99 days later. That is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The posted amount is 5519 cents. Authorisation AUTH-008308 was approved for 5018 cents by chip with PIN verified. The merchant, MER-000065 (Lumen Kitchen), is in the RESTAURANT category. No receipt is attached. The cardholder's statement that the bill was 50.18 EUR is a claim, not a receipt, and it matches the authorised amount. The posted amount is 501 cents above the authorised amount. 20% of the authorised amount is 1003.6 cents, so the difference is within the restaurant tip tolerance. Under amount-restaurant-tip, this counts as an agreed tip, not a mismatch, so the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: The restaurant authorised 50.18 EUR and posted 55.19 EUR. Restaurants may add a tip of up to 20% of the authorised amount (up to 10.03 EUR here). The 5.01 EUR difference is within that limit, so it is treated as an agreed tip rather than an incorrect amount.
